notes: 7" 1920x1200 IPS touchscreen on-camera field monitor, 2200 cd/m² brightness, 3D LUT support; handheld/on-camera unit, not rack-mountable (mounts via 1/4"-20 thread on bottom/left/right). Cross-checked B&H Photo spec table (bhphotovideo.com, BH#FELUT7S/MFR#LUT7S) against the manufacturer's own product page (feelworld.ltd) — both agree: 1x HDMI 1.4 in + 1x HDMI 1.4 out, 1x 3G-SDI (BNC) in + 1x 3G-SDI (BNC) out, 1x 3.5mm headphone out, DC power input (7-24VDC, ≤20W, B&H lists nominal 12VDC/2.1mm barrel), and a secondary DC barrel output (~8.4VDC) for powering an accessory/camera via optional cable — manufacturer's page gives that output barrel as 3.5mm OD/1.1mm ID rather than B&H's stated 2.1mm, a minor sourcing discrepancy on that one port's exact barrel size (mapped to dc-barrel regardless). Included accessory cable is "Micro-HDMI to HDMI"; product listings don't explicitly state whether the monitor's own HDMI ports are full-size or micro/mini, so the cable is most likely for adapting a camera's micro-HDMI output to the monitor's HDMI port — mapped as standard hdmi connector per both spec tables, but treat as low-confidence on that specific sub-detail. Device does not support HDMI/SDI cross-conversion. Power is also supplemented by a dual Sony L-series/NP-F battery plate (not a fixed connector type in the given enum, so omitted as a port).
